title: Let’s repeat what we learned
intro: The pillars of Salah, the bathroom dua, the protecting surahs, ghusl, tayammum and the last sitting.

learn.html: Let’s repeat! Say the missing words with your muallim:

items: The pillars of Salah are ____ parts we must do ______ Salah, so it is right and complete.
We go into the bathroom with the ______ foot and say: Allaahumma innee ______.
We come out with the ______ foot and say: ______ – I ask Your forgiveness.
The Prophet (SAW) recommended reciting, morning and ______, Qul ______ and the two protecting surahs: ______ and ______.
Ghusl is a required religious ______ for adult Muslims in a state of ______. Its three fard are: ______, ______ and ______.
Tayammum is touching ______ for a symbolic ______.
In the last sitting we recite: ______, ______ and ______.

questions.q: How many pillars of Salah are there?
Which foot do we enter the bathroom with?
Which are the two protecting surahs?
What do we recite in the last sitting?
